claims.claim: The Abductor Virgin at the bottom of Raya Lucaria's waterwheel can trigger a death teleport to Volcano Manor's Subterranean Inquisition Chamber.
The Subterranean Inquisition Chamber is a real grace and branches into the lava route toward the main manor and the lower Abductor Virgins cave; these are separate planes/branches.
Guest Hall is an explicit Volcano Manor grace on the central castle route and its cage-elevator/upper path can reach the Godskin Noble approach, distinct from the Prison Town Church approach.

notes: The death teleport is represented as a selectable state transition; it is not a claim that the current save has triggered it.
No game process, save file, archive, memory or foreground window was accessed.
